UserProfile.title: UserProfile
UserProfile.description: Authenticated Unity Hub account profile synced with Google Sign-In.

userId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the account owner.

email.description: Primary email address associated with the Unity ID.

fullName.description: Full display name of the Unity developer.

emailVerified.description: Whether the 6-digit email verification code or Google email check completed.

photoUrl.description: Optional profile avatar URL from Google account.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the profile was created (FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the profile was last updated (FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

/users/{userId}.description: Private Unity ID profile document scoped strictly to the owning Firebase user.
